NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA全栈平台和极致软硬件协同设计，构建数据中心级AI基础设施，赋能全行业AI应用
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Builds data-center-scale AI infrastructure with a full-stack platform of extreme co-design to power AI across all industries
concrete_bets: Extreme co-design of chips, networking, systems, and software

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Microsoft Cloud为基座，通过Copilot与智能体将AI嵌入全栈生产力，并坚守负责任AI。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embed AI across the full stack via Microsoft Cloud, Copilot, and agents, with responsible AI.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge AI platform

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台将生成式AI与企业数据、本体及运营决策深度整合，实现政府和商业领域的负责任AI优势。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate generative AI with enterprise and government data through AIP to enable responsible AI advantage.
concrete_bets: Unified access to open-source and commercial LLMs

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动社交产品体验，重点发展Meta AI助手与AI眼镜等下一代计算平台
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: AI-powered social experiences via Meta AI assistant and AI glasses for next-gen computing platforms
concrete_bets: Reality Labs AI and AR R&D

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 围绕编码agent、Codex等工具如何改变软件工程实践与工作流。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Coding agents and Codex tools reshape software engineering practice and workflows.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦推理深度、循环Transformer、水印与文本检测等模型内部机制研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Research on reasoning effort, looped transformers, watermarking, and text detection internals.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及量化、剪枝、tokenizer扩展、MLX内核及搜索加速等部署与推理效率工作。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Quantization, pruning, tokenizers, MLX kernels, and search acceleration for efficient inference.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖智能体可靠性、信念更新、数据系统及各领域benchmark评测。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Agent reliability, belief updating, agent-native data systems, and domain benchmarks.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 展示生成式AI在视频、教育、医学、物流、气候等垂直领域的实际应用。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Generative AI applied across video, education, genomics, logistics, and climate domains.

alias.notes: Only 'Enterprise AI Platform' had no clear canonical equivalent among the known names. Other raw themes were mapped to existing canonicals, including spelling/scope variants such as 'AI系统可观测性' → 'AI系统可观测性/成本' and the AI coding agent variants → 'AI编码agent当硬技能'. 'Foundation Models' and '企业数据上的应用LLM' were treated as overlapping with 'LLM/生成式AI应用'.
